item.title: Colin Gray Trial: Closing Arguments Expected Today
item.description: Closing arguments are expected in Colin Gray's trial after he took the stand last week. Gray is standing trial for his alleged role in a shooting that killed four people at a Georgia high school. Kouri Richins' trial enters day six. (3/2/26)

item.title: Ex-MLB pitcher Dan Serafini sentenced for shooting wife’s parents
item.description: Auburn, Calif. (AP) — Former MLB pitcher Daniel Serafini was sentenced Friday to life in prison without the possibility of parole in the 2021 shooting of his wife’s parents during a burglary at their home by Lake Tahoe, authorities said. item.title: Colo. man accused of murdering ex-wife, staging scene to look like suicide
item.description: A grand jury in Arapahoe County has indicted Ronald Lowry, 52, for first-degree murder in the 2023 death of his estranged wife, Richelle, at her Bennett home. item.description: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. item.title: UT v. Kouri Richins: Key Moments from Day 5
item.description: On day five, Carmen Lauber, the Richins' family housekeeper returned to the stand. Robert Crozier, an admitted drug dealer also took the stand in Kouri Richins' murder trial. (2/27/26)

item.title: Colin Gray ‘Charged With These Crimes Because He Shares the Blame’: State
item.description: The State presents its closing argument in Colin Gray's trial where the father of Colt Gray, an accused school shooter, is standing trial for his alleged role in the shooting that killed four people at a Georgia high school. (3/2/26)

item.title: Kouri Richins and Medical Examiner Discuss Eric Richins’ Toxicology Report
item.description: The jury listens to a phone call between Kouri Richins and a medical examiner, where Kouri asks questions about her husband, Eric Richins' toxicology report. Kouri is accused of poisoning Eric with a lethal dose of fentanyl. (3/2/26)

item.title: Lindsay Clancy Wants Trial For Kids’ Murders Split In Two Parts
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's attorney wants her murder trial to be split into two phases. Clancy is charged with murdering her three young children. (3/1/26)

item.title: Colin Gray Defense: Colt Gray ‘Is The Person Who Needs to Be Punished’
item.description: Colin Gray's defense attorney places the blame for the Apalachee High School shooting on Colt Gray, while holding a picture of Colt he says, 'This is the person that went into the high school and killed four people he didn't even know. This is the person who needs to be punished.' (3/2/26)
